forum.header.categoriesBody: Shape navigation clusters, assign moderation rules, and keep every forum area ready for new threads.
forum.header.topicsBody: Review topic flow, open a thread for reply preview, and keep publishing controls next to the live feed.
forum.error.categoryRequired: Category name and slug are required.
forum.error.topicRequired: Category, title and body are required.
forum.error.replyTopicRequired: Open a topic before posting a reply.
forum.error.localeSwitchDirty: Save or reset unsaved changes before switching content locale.
forum.error.localeSwitchInvalid: Content locale must not be empty.
forum.error.localeSwitchPending: Apply or reset the pending content locale before saving.
forum.error.localeSwitchReplyDirty: Post or clear the unsaved reply before switching topic locale.
forum.categories.matrixBody: This view keeps category hierarchy, counts, and moderation switches close together so moderators can shape the forum like a community map instead of a plain CRUD table.
forum.categories.noteIconBody: Use both so each category reads like a quick visual stop in the sidebar.
forum.categories.notePositionBody: Lower numbers bubble important sections to the top of the community map.
forum.categories.noteModeratedBody: Turn this on for queues that need stricter review before topics go live.
forum.form.localeHintCategory: Published locale for this category. Load a different locale explicitly before editing its translation.
forum.form.localeHintTopic: Thread locale for publishing and reads. Load another locale explicitly before editing its translation.
forum.form.name: Name
forum.form.nameHint: Human-friendly label shown in the admin and forum nav.
forum.form.slugHintCategory: Stable identifier for routing and lookups.
forum.form.iconHint: Optional short token or icon name.
forum.form.positionHint: Lower comes first in the list.
forum.form.moderatedHint: Topics in this category should flow through stricter review.
forum.form.categoryHint: Choose where the topic should live.
forum.form.title: Title
forum.form.bodyHint: Main message shown in the topic detail.
forum.topics.navigationBody: A left rail similar to NodeBB: jump between categories, keep counts visible, and open a thread into the editor on the right.
forum.topics.streamBody: Open a topic card to inspect replies and edit the thread without leaving the feed.
forum.replies.bodyHint: Write a focused response using the shared discussion editor.
forum.render.openTopicForReplies: Open a topic card to preview replies.
forum.categories.seo.title: Category SEO
forum.categories.seo.subtitle: Explicit metadata, social tags and diagnostics for the selected forum category.
forum.categories.seo.empty: Create or open a category first. SEO stays attached to the forum category editor.
forum.topics.seo.title: Topic SEO
forum.topics.seo.subtitle: Explicit metadata, social tags and diagnostics for the selected forum topic.
forum.topics.seo.empty: Create or open a topic first. SEO stays attached to the forum thread editor.
forum.merge.title: Merge topics
forum.merge.subtitle: Archive one source thread into a retained target through the idempotent Forum owner.
forum.merge.retryHint: Retries keep this identity until source, target, reason, or solution choice changes.
forum.merge.notEnough: At least two active topics are required.
forum.merge.errorSource: Choose the source topic to archive.
forum.slugRename.title: Rename topic route
forum.slugRename.subtitle: Change one existing localized topic slug while the Forum owner records the old route as an immutable redirect.
forum.slugRename.slugHint: The owner normalizes the route segment and preserves the previous path.
forum.slugRename.replay: The canonical slug was already current; no new alias was written.
forum.slugRename.warning: This changes only an existing localized route. Locale creation, route deletion and canonical merge policy remain owner-controlled.
forum.slugRename.errorTopic: Choose the topic route to rename.
forum.split.title: Split topic replies
forum.split.subtitle: Create a new topic from one parent-closed set of replies through the idempotent Forum owner.
forum.split.noReplies: Choose a source topic with at least two replies.
forum.split.retryHint: Exact retries keep both identities. Editing the source, selection or target fields rotates both.
forum.fork.title: Fork reply branch
forum.fork.subtitle: Copy one reply branch into a new topic while the Forum owner preserves the source.
forum.fork.noReplies: Choose a source topic with at least one reply.
forum.fork.warning: Fork copies the selected root and its descendants. The source topic, replies and solution remain unchanged.
forum.fork.retryHint: Exact retries keep both identities. Editing the source, root or target fields rotates both.
forum.replyRange.title: Move reply range
forum.replyRange.subtitle: Move one inclusive owner-position range into an existing topic.
forum.replyRange.warning: Use canonical owner positions, not row numbers. The owner validates occupied endpoints, bounds, parent edges, ACL, solutions and counters.
forum.replyRange.retryHint: Exact retries keep this identity. Editing source, target, either endpoint or reason rotates it.
